Company description: MRK (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

MRK refers to Merck & Co., Inc., a leading global healthcare company headquartered in Rahway, New Jersey. Traded on the New York Stock Exchange, the company traces its lineage back to 1891 as the United States subsidiary of the historic German firm Merck. Following expropriation during World War I, it became an independent American enterprise in 1917 and merged with Sharp & Dohme in 1953. Merck operates primarily as a research-intensive biopharmaceutical company, discovering, developing, and marketing a broad portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, biologic therapies, and animal health products. Its commercial success is anchored by breakthrough innovations in oncology, infectious diseases, and immunology, notably including life-saving cancer immunotherapies and vaccines that address critical global health challenges. Through substantial investments in research and development, Merck continues to advance medical science and deliver therapeutic solutions to patients worldwide.
